default.notes: Arrange a visa in advance through a Congolese embassy — tourist visas are typically issued for 30 days; an official e-visa channel has been introduced but roll-out is uneven, so confirm the current procedure before booking.

groups.notes: CEMAC citizens enter the Republic of the Congo freely under the Community’s free-movement arrangements with a valid passport or national ID.

CG.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Congolese citizens.
